screen.enderscape.config.option.ambience:
§eOnly effective after restarting!§r

Updates foliage colors in End biomes that use default foliage colors.

§eOnly effective after restarting!§r

Updates grass colors in End biomes that use default grass colors.

§eOnly effective after restarting!§r

Updates water colors in End biomes that use default water colors.

Updates water fog colors in End biomes that use default water fog colors.
screen.enderscape.config.option.chorus_f: When enabled, Chorus Flowers will occasionally emit deep humming.
When enabled, Chorus Flowers will emit pollen particles.
screen.enderscape.config.option.creative:
§eOnly effective after world restart!§r

When enabled, Enderscape will have its own Creative Mode tab, featuring all items from Enderscape and relevant vanilla items.
screen.enderscape.config.option.edit_wor: Add "Enderscape Data Packs" button to Edit World screen

When enabled, an "Enderscape Data Packs" button will be present on the Edit World screen.

It allows you to enable and disable Enderscape's data packs after world creation.
screen.enderscape.config.option.elytra_a:
When enabled, gliding with Elytra will play a new gliding sound.

Other players will also be able to hear it from afar!
When enabled, opening and closing your elytra will play new sounds.
screen.enderscape.config.option.elytra_f: When enabled, gliding with Elytra will influence your FOV.
screen.enderscape.config.option.elytra_h:
When enabled, gliding with Elytra will exhaust hunger over time.

The exhaustion rate is the same as swimming, which is ten times less than sprinting.
screen.enderscape.config.option.elytra_s: When enabled, pressing the sneak key allows you to instantly stop gliding.
screen.enderscape.config.option.elytra_u: When enabled, Elytra will have a unique sound upon equipping.
screen.enderscape.config.option.end_flas: End Flash frequency in minutes. (0.5 would be 30 seconds)

§eRequires enabling Updated Skybox!§r

When enabled, End Flashes will darken the sky.

§eChoose between different End Flash styles.§r

Occasionally, a bright flash will appear in the End's sky. Improved End Flashes feature a new texture and biome-specific coloration.
screen.enderscape.config.option.end_port: When enabled, End Portals will have unique particles.
When enabled, there will be a unique sound for travelling to the End.
screen.enderscape.config.option.ender_pe: When enabled, Ender Pearls will create portal particles when flying through the air.
When enabled, Ender Pearls will create shattering particles like Eggs when hitting the ground.
When enabled, Ender Pearls' teleporting sound will be updated.
When enabled, Ender Pearls will have a unique throwing sound.
screen.enderscape.config.option.enderman:
§eOnly effective after restarting!§r

When enabled, angering an Enderman will make your vision distorted.

§eOnly effective after restarting!§r

When enabled, the eyes of Endermen will have light pupils in darkness, and dark pupils in brightness.

When enabled, Endermen stare sounds will be tied to the player that they are angry at.

When the Enderman is defeated or their anger quelled, the sound will quickly fade.

§eOnly effective after restarting!§r

When enabled, Endermen feature improved animations via an improved model.
screen.enderscape.config.option.endermit: When enabled, Endermite eyes will be emissive.
When enabled, Endermites will be easier to hit.
Only spawn naturally in dark areas

When enabled, Endermites will only spawn naturally in dark areas. Normally, they ignore light level.

This change does not apply to Monster Spawners or Trial Spawners.
When enabled, Endermites will have unique sounds.
screen.enderscape.config.option.entity_u: When enabled, Endermen and Endermites will emit updated particles.
screen.enderscape.config.option.fog_dens:
When enabled, fog in the End will be denser and scale properly with your render distance.

May conflict with other mods.
screen.enderscape.config.option.include_: Include colored Mirrors in Tools & Utilities tab

§eOnly effective after world restart!§r

When enabled, colored Mirrors will appear in vanilla's Tools & Utilities tab.
Include Enderscape items in vanilla tabs

§eOnly effective after world restart!§r

When enabled, Enderscape items will appear in vanilla Creative Mode tabs.
screen.enderscape.config.option.lighting:
§e
Choose between different lighting styles.§r

Improves gamma scaling and End flash effects. Choose Midnight lighting for a dark and moody appearance.
screen.enderscape.config.option.mirror_s: When enabled, teleporting with the Mirror will display a screen overlay effect.
screen.enderscape.config.option.mirror_t: Displays the coordinates of the Lodestone the Mirror is linked to.
Displays the dimension of the Lodestone the Mirror is linked to.
Displays the approximate distance to the Lodestone the Mirror is linked to.

Maybe you'd prefer not to show where your Mirror leads to...

When enabled, hold SHIFT to see your Mirror's linked block information.
screen.enderscape.config.option.nebulite: When enabled, holding a Nebulite tool (e.g., Mirror, Magnia Attractor) displays a HUD element above the crosshair showing current energy and usage cost.
screen.enderscape.config.option.outer_vo:
The height threshold where entities are considered below the world.

Using a threshold of -8 with Improved End Terrain means you begin taking damage at -72 instead of -128.
screen.enderscape.config.option.portal_p: Makes Nether Portal, Enderman, Ender Chest, and related particles emissive.
screen.enderscape.config.option.rubble_s: When enabled, dashing with Rubble Shields will influence your FOV.
screen.enderscape.config.option.rubblemi: When enabled, Rubblemites will be easier to hit.
screen.enderscape.config.option.shulker_: The maximum amount of Shulker Bullets a Shulker can have at once. Disabled when set to 0.
The maximum distance between Shulker Bullets and their target before disappearing. Disabled when set to 0.
When enabled, Shulker Bullets will disappear when their owner dies.
The time limit in seconds before a Shulker Bullet disappears. Disabled when set to 0.
When enabled, Shulker Bullets play a new sound while moving.
When enabled, Shulker Bullets inflict stronger but shorter Levitation on players they hit.
Hurt by piercing arrows when closed
When enabled, Shulkers will be hurt by arrows with piercing even when their shells are closed.
screen.enderscape.config.option.silverfi: Delay before infesting stone after emerging
When enabled, Silverfish will have a delay before they can re-infest stone after emerging.
When enabled, Silverfish will be easier to hit.
Only spawn naturally in dark areas

When enabled, Silverfish will only spawn naturally in dark areas. Normally, they ignore light level.

This change does not apply to Monster Spawners or Trial Spawners.
screen.enderscape.config.option.skybox_b:
Adjusts skybox brightness by a percentage of game brightness.

Designed to alleviate visibility issues. Changing this option drastically could look bad.
screen.enderscape.config.option.skybox_u:
§eUpdates the End skybox to be more interesting and dynamic.§r

Adds subtle stars and nebulae throughout, as well as the ability to change color between biomes.
screen.enderscape.config.option.structur:
When enabled, entering a structure will fade out existing background music to then play its own music.

Exiting the structure will fade away its music as well.

Currently supports Strongholds and End Cities.
screen.enderscape.config.option.suppleme:
§eOnly effective in vanilla End Cities!§r

When enabled, vanilla End Cities will feature additional items, including Enderscape items such as Stasis Armor Trim, Mirror, etc.

§eOnly effective in vanilla Strongholds!§r

When enabled, vanilla Stronghold libraries will occasionally include Mirrors.
screen.enderscape.config.option.tridents: Tridents with Loyalty return from outer void
When enabled, Tridents with the Loyalty enchantment return to you after entering the outer void instead of disappearing forever.
screen.enderscape.config.option.update_c: Update Chorus Plant and Flower sound types

§eOnly effective after restarting!§r

Updates Chorus Plant and Chorus Flower to sound like dry, coarse wood.
screen.enderscape.config.option.update_e: Update End Portal Frame sound type

§eOnly effective after restarting!§r

Updates End Portal Frames to sound unique.
Update End Portal and End Gateway sound types

§eOnly effective after restarting!§r

Updates End Portal and End Gateway blocks to sound unique.

§eOnly effective after restarting!§r

Updates End Rods to sound like tinny, worbly little rods.
Update End Stone Bricks sound type

§eOnly effective after restarting!§r

Updates End Stone Bricks to sound like dense, heavy bricks.

§eOnly effective after restarting!§r

Updates End Stone to sound like dense, somewhat fertile stone.
screen.enderscape.config.option.update_p:
§eOnly effective after restarting!§r

Updates Purpur to sound like tiles.
screen.enderscape.config.option.update_s:
§eOnly effective after restarting!§r

Updates Shulker Boxes to sound a bit more like Shulkers.

When enabled, a warning will be displayed when loading worlds that haven't been used with Enderscape.
screen.enderscape.config.option.void_poo: When enabled, Endermen, Endermites, and Rubblemites will emit black cloud particles upon death.
